2022-04-24 Kennedy Center Concert Hall, Washington, DC

Share: 

Scheduled: ??:?? Local Start Time ??:?? / End Time ??:??

Info & Setlist | Venue

Springsteen performed at the 23rd annual Mark Twain Prize for American Humor which was presented to Jon Stewart. Together with Gary Clark Jr. he kicked off the event with a version of "Come Together". Later he returned to the stage for a solo acoustic performance of "Born To Run".
